info.title: Thesis: evidence-level synthesis
info.description: The supervisor's flow: question, protocol (or a proposal), corpus, run, evidence graph, answer and scores with the baselines beside the engine; the jobs that make them.

post.description: The deterministic checks of the draft with these decisions applied (no model call).

get.description: One paper's text with the hits of the draft's screen terms, the frame's names and the method kinds.
The live run trace: warm-pass calls, then the engine events, rows numbered from 1; `after` is the last row number held.
The agent baseline's own run (its agent-runs/ directory).

200.description: the last lines of the job's log

post.description: Real papers from the arXiv API as a demonstration corpus (no ground truth: runs on it are not scored).

get.description: The group a run with this protocol and selection is written under (runs/<group>/<name>).

question.title: Question
question.description: the question's id in the questions file: the question the baseline answers

source.title: Source
source.description: the agent's own run directory, or the record the engine's cache keeps of it

Best.title: Best
Best.description:
A best-method question: conditions are grouped into method kinds; inside each paper the kind with the
top value of `metric` wins. `kinds` maps a kind to the condition names that belong to it.

BestAnswer.title: BestAnswer
BestAnswer.description: evidence/kinds/best.py: which method kind has the top value inside each paper, and wins most papers.

Bound.title: Bound
Bound.description:
A range a numeric field must lie in, checked by the engine (rejected with reason schema otherwise);
e.g. a measurement of an accuracy or a rate is a fraction in [0, 1].

BuildsOnAnswer.title: BuildsOnAnswer
BuildsOnAnswer.description: evidence/kinds/builds_on.py: which papers build on which, and how influential each compared thing is.

BuildsOnQ.title: BuildsOnQ
BuildsOnQ.description:
A builds-on question (spec section 6.18): which studies build on which, for one compared thing (`thing`) or
for every one (None).

task.title: Task
task.description: the ExtractionTask, from the record cache

cached.title: Cached
cached.description: the record cache holds this call

record_note.title: Record Note
record_note.description: why the cache cannot hold this call (a fresh call of a re-execution)

agent_runs.title: Agent Runs
agent_runs.description: agent run ids behind an agentic call

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: regex, llm, model or agent (the extractor spec's kind)

focus.title: Focus
focus.description: the gap a targeted task was made for (Part D)

CallSummary.title: CallSummary
CallSummary.description: One extractor call of the run, from its extractor_call event (Part D: screen calls too).

decision.description: the decision of decisions.yaml (or, once frozen, of proposal.json, which records the default beside it)

raw_decision.title: Raw Decision
raw_decision.description: the card's entry in decisions.yaml as written, when it is not a decision's shape (a hand edit gone wrong)

problems.title: Problems
problems.description: what freeze would refuse about this card's decision

ChainStep.title: ChainStep
ChainStep.description: One step of a chaining path: a comparison of `from` and `to` in one paper; `direction` is from over to.

Chaining.title: Chaining
Chaining.description:
A chaining question (spec section 6.10): is `source` better than `target` on `metric`, through compared
things each was tested against (at most `max_hops` steps)? `min_effect` is the neutral band of every step.

ChainingAnswer.title: ChainingAnswer
ChainingAnswer.description:
evidence/kinds/chaining.py: is the source better than the target, directly or through things each was
compared with? `reason` is the rule that decided (null when a chain concluded).

check.title: Check
check.description: a critic check id, or `decision` for a decision cards.validate refuses

severity.title: Severity
severity.description: serious: freeze refuses it unless a person waives it

card.title: Card
card.description: the card to look at, when one is the cause

decisions.title: Decisions
decisions.description: the decisions as the form holds them now

quote.title: Quote
quote.description: accepted: the exact text anchored in the corpus; rejected: the quote as sent

Compare.title: Compare
Compare.description: The condition roles a study's pair is made of: the effect is treatment against control.

name.title: Name
name.description: the output directory under the scores root, e.g. compare-funnel-<corpus>

Consistency.title: Consistency
Consistency.description: A consistency question: does what the authors claim agree with what they measured?

ConsistencyAnswer.title: ConsistencyAnswer
ConsistencyAnswer.description: evidence/kinds/consistency.py: does what the authors claim agree with what they measured?

name.title: Name
name.description: the directory name under the corpora root

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: corpus.json settings: name, studies, mix, levels and the knobs (duplicates, missing, outliers, irrelevant)

fidelity_ok.title: Fidelity Ok
fidelity_ok.description: papers whose fidelity checks all pass

base.title: Base
base.description: the base corpus of a variant, by directory name, when it is here

ground_truth.title: Ground Truth
ground_truth.description: false for a demonstration corpus of real papers (source.json `ground_truth: false`, `evidence fetch`): nothing to score against

source.description: source.json: where the papers came from (arXiv)

study.title: Study
study.description: the study's ground truth (conditions, metrics, measurements, author claim, effect)

skipped.title: Skipped
skipped.description: papers whose PDF could not be fetched or converted, and why

CorpusSource.title: CorpusSource
CorpusSource.description: source.json of a corpus of real papers (`evidence fetch`, evidence/arxiv.py).

name.title: Name
name.description: the directory name under the corpora root

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: corpus.json settings: name, studies, mix, levels and the knobs (duplicates, missing, outliers, irrelevant)

fidelity_ok.title: Fidelity Ok
fidelity_ok.description: papers whose fidelity checks all pass

base.title: Base
base.description: the base corpus of a variant, by directory name, when it is here

ground_truth.title: Ground Truth
ground_truth.description: false for a demonstration corpus of real papers (source.json `ground_truth: false`, `evidence fetch`): nothing to score against

source.description: source.json: where the papers came from (arXiv)

choice.title: Choice
choice.description: an option id of the card, or custom (with a value)

value.title: Value
value.description: only with choice custom: the value in the card's shape

by.title: By
by.description: who decided: `model` (the model's default, kept), the server's $WEBAPP_USER (decided in the app), or the name decisions.yaml already has for this card (kept as it is)

waivers.title: Waivers
waivers.description: serious problems the person waives; written to decisions.yaml as {check, reason, by: the server's user}

base_sha256.title: Base Sha256
base_sha256.description: decisions_sha256 of the proposal as the form loaded it (null: there was no decisions.yaml); refused with 409 if the file changed since

force.title: Force
force.description: write even though decisions.yaml changed since it was loaded

sha256.title: Sha256
sha256.description: its sha256 now: the base_sha256 of the next PUT

DependencyLink.title: DependencyLink
DependencyLink.description: A paper (`from`) that builds on an earlier one (`to`), reusing a method, dataset or result.

EffectAnswer.title: EffectAnswer
EffectAnswer.description: An effect answer: today's shape, no `kind` key (old answer.json files have none).

ev.title: Ev
ev.description: $EV, the root the others default to (docs/slurm-evidence-runbook.md)

agent_work.description: the agentic extractor's agent run directories

questions.description: the questions file (domains/rag/questions.yaml; `exists`: the file is there)

jobs.description: $EV/.jobs: the state and logs of the jobs the app starts (none without $EV)

user.title: User
user.description: who decides a card in the app (`by` in decisions.yaml, $WEBAPP_USER)

default_model.title: Default Model
default_model.description: the model alias every model job uses unless told otherwise (orch-model)

llm_base_url.title: Llm Base Url
llm_base_url.description: the model gateway the jobs reach ($LITELLM_BASE_URL)

llm_key_set.title: Llm Key Set
llm_key_set.description: whether $LITELLM_MASTER_KEY is set in the server's environment

model_jobs.title: Model Jobs
model_jobs.description: model jobs that run at a time; the rest queue

levels.title: Levels
levels.description: the synthetic corpus levels a template build can write (synth/levels.py)

group.title: Group
group.description: the output directory the run was written to (regex-only, cascade, rag-baseline, ...)

complete.title: Complete
complete.description: engine: run.json is written (else the run crashed or is still running; its events and calls are shown, its answer is not there yet)

corpus.title: Corpus
corpus.description: the corpus directory under the corpora root, when it is there

error_calls.title: Error Calls
error_calls.description: engine: extractor calls the model gateway or the GLiNER service failed, in whole or in part (calls/*.json status error or partial with reason model_call or service_call); `--retry-errors` runs them again

documents.title: Documents
documents.description: the manifest's paper ids, in order

baselines.title: Baselines
baselines.description: baseline runs (ids) of the same corpus

has_trace.title: Has Trace
has_trace.description: baseline: the agent baseline's run directory is there

link_flags.title: Link Flags
link_flags.description: engine: links to an item of the wrong kind (reason.json `link_flags`); null when the run has no reason.json

display.title: Display
display.description: engine: the run's pack's display names (pack.yaml `display`), e.g. what the treatment and control sides are called; empty for a baseline or when the pack cannot be read

group.title: Group
group.description: the output directory the run was written to (regex-only, cascade, rag-baseline, ...)

complete.title: Complete
complete.description: engine: run.json is written (else the run crashed or is still running; its events and calls are shown, its answer is not there yet)

corpus.title: Corpus
corpus.description: the corpus directory under the corpora root, when it is there

error_calls.title: Error Calls
error_calls.description: engine: extractor calls the model gateway or the GLiNER service failed, in whole or in part (calls/*.json status error or partial with reason model_call or service_call); `--retry-errors` runs them again

EvidenceLine.title: EvidenceLine
EvidenceLine.description:
One line of evidence to look for; the oversell line has `removable=False`. `how`: the plain sentences shown
under "how?" (never code), kept with the line so a reloaded plan still has them.

ExtractionResult.title: ExtractionResult
ExtractionResult.description: What every extractor returns (contract section 5); canonical order so it hashes the same.

ExtractorRef.title: ExtractorRef
ExtractorRef.description: One step of a cascade: a registered extractor name and its configuration.

ExtractorSpec.title: ExtractorSpec
ExtractorSpec.description: Identity of one extractor version (contract section 3).

query.title: Query
query.description: search words; every word must occur in the paper's arXiv record

max_papers.title: Max Papers
max_papers.description: papers to fetch (one request every three seconds)

FetchRequest.title: FetchRequest
FetchRequest.description:
`evidence fetch` (evidence/arxiv.py): real papers from the arXiv API into `$EV/corpora/<name>`, a
demonstration corpus with no ground truth. The name defaults to `arxiv-<slug of the query>-<yyyymmdd>`.

Inventory.title: Inventory
Inventory.description:
An inventory question: list every distinct item of one evidence type. `target` is any evidence type the
protocol declares whose pack type has a name field (Protocol checks both); `same` maps a canonical name to the
other names it goes by.

InventoryAnswer.title: InventoryAnswer
InventoryAnswer.description: evidence/kinds/inventory.py: every distinct item of one type the papers report.

Item.title: Item
Item.description: One piece of evidence: typed fields plus checked spans (contract section 5).

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: synth, run, rag-baseline, agent-baseline, score, compare, propose, freeze

lane.title: Lane
lane.description: model: calls a model, queued one (WEBAPP_MODEL_JOBS) at a time; cpu: no model call, runs beside them (WEBAPP_CPU_JOBS at a time)

args.title: Args
args.description: the request the job was made from

refs.title: Refs
refs.description: what the job writes, as viewer ids: corpus, run, score, proposal

warnings.title: Warnings
warnings.description: optional steps that failed (the job can still be done)

failed_calls.title: Failed Calls
failed_calls.description: an engine run's extractor calls the model gateway or the GLiNER service failed (calls/*.json status error or partial with reason model_call or service_call): done, but with failed calls

orphaned.title: Orphaned
orphaned.description: the server that started it stopped while its process ran on; this server watches the process and can cancel it

command.title: Command
command.description: argv as one shell-quoted line, for reading

required.title: Required
required.description: a failure fails the job (an optional step's failure is a warning)

needs.title: Needs
needs.description: files the step needs; it is skipped when one is missing

pid.title: Pid
pid.description: the running command's process id (also its process group's)

pid_start.title: Pid Start
pid_start.description: the process's start time (/proc/<pid>/stat), so a reused pid is never taken for the job's process

KindRequest.title: KindRequest
KindRequest.description:
Say which kind of question a proposal asks, instead of the model's guess: the draft, critic and cards
steps run again from that kind's template (the cards and decisions made so far are dropped).

LabelRow.title: LabelRow
LabelRow.description: One row of the label decision table: every condition in `when` must hold on the counts.

LimitationsAnswer.title: LimitationsAnswer
LimitationsAnswer.description: evidence/kinds/limitations.py: the limitations the papers state, per compared thing and category.

LimitationsQ.title: LimitationsQ
LimitationsQ.description:
A limitations question (spec section 6.18): the limitations papers report, for one compared thing (`thing`)
or for every one (None).

systems.title: Systems
systems.description: system -> its headline score on the question

engine_loss.title: Engine Loss
engine_loss.description: the engine's headline is below the best baseline's, or its label (effect) or winner (best) is wrong

cause.title: Cause
cause.description: an engine loss's first cause; null when not a loss

report.title: Report
report.description: the score report (`<group>~<name>`) the row comes from

Losses.title: Losses
Losses.description:
losses.json of `evaluate losses` (evaluation/losses.py `losses(reports)`): per domain, the questions with
the engine's losses first, then by question id.

losses.description: null when the scores root has no losses/losses.json

agent_run.title: Agent Run
agent_run.description: an agentic call: the agent run's id (its trace)

ModelCallRecord.title: ModelCallRecord
ModelCallRecord.description: One record of the engine's record cache (evidence/recording.py): request, response, usage, error.

Pairing.title: Pairing
Pairing.description:
How a study's treatment and control measurements are chosen (evidence/synthesis.py): on the same
dataset (the first dataset in document order that has both), preferring, in order, a value in a table
cell over prose and the earlier value over the later one.

Plan.title: Plan
Plan.description:
`measures`: the thing ids (keys of `words.things`) that are measures (a score, a rate); the other things are
compared things, the first of them the one the question asks about (the treatment side of a plan run).

PlanResult.title: PlanResult
PlanResult.description: The run's result: W4's after_run output (evidence.planner.lines.run_lines) with the reruns.

card.title: Card
card.description: the card whose terms hit here: screen, roles, metrics or method_kinds

what.title: What
what.description: the term or name that hit

steps.title: Steps
steps.description: the steps whose files exist: frame, draft, critic, cards, freeze

checks.title: Checks
checks.description: critic.json checks (deterministic and the LLM checklist)

proposal.title: Proposal
proposal.description: proposal.json, written by freeze, without the frame, sources and critic it repeats

revisions.title: Revisions
revisions.description: the frozen and amended revisions kept as protocol.v<N>.yaml

decision_problems.title: Decision Problems
decision_problems.description: before freeze: everything freeze would refuse in decisions.yaml (evidence/propose/cards.validate)

waivers.title: Waivers
waivers.description: before freeze: the waivers decisions.yaml holds; a save that does not send one back removes it

decisions_sha256.title: Decisions Sha256
decisions_sha256.description: sha256 of decisions.yaml as read; a PUT of the decisions sends it back and is refused if the file changed since

steps.title: Steps
steps.description: the steps whose files exist: frame, draft, critic, cards, freeze

question.title: Question
question.description: the question's id in the questions file

text.title: Text
text.description: a question the person typed, instead of one of the questions file

ProposeRequest.title: ProposeRequest
ProposeRequest.description:
The proposal flow's frame, draft, critic and cards steps into `$EV/proposals/<proposal>` (resumed from the
first step whose file is missing).

source.title: Source
source.description: repo: a hand-written protocol under the protocols directory; proposal: a frozen proposal's protocol.yaml

protocol.description: the parsed protocol; null when it does not validate

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: what the question asks: an effect, an inventory, whether claims agree with results (consistency), or which method kind is best

protocol.title: Protocol
protocol.description: the hand-written protocol's name under the protocols directory (`/api/ev/protocols/{name}`), or null: the question needs a proposal

agentic_protocol.title: Agentic Protocol
agentic_protocol.description: its variant with the agentic extractor, when there is one

proposals.title: Proposals
proposals.description: proposals (by directory name) whose frame asks this question

question.title: Question
question.description: the question's id in the questions file: the question the baseline answers

Report.title: Report
Report.description:
report.json of `evaluate score` (evaluation/report.py): A extraction, B integration, C synthesis per
level, intervals, locate, cascade, extractors, cost, stability, funnel.

path.title: Path
path.description: absolute path, or null when not configured

RunGroup.title: RunGroup
RunGroup.description: The group `evidence run` writes under for a protocol and selection (`runs/<group>/<name>`).

text.title: Text
text.description: null when the run's corpus is not under the corpora root

group.title: Group
group.description: default as the runbook names it: regex-only, cascade, cascade-gaps, agentic, agentic-gaps, or <protocol>-...

retry_errors.title: Retry Errors
retry_errors.description: `--retry-errors`: run cached error results again instead of taking them from the record cache

RunRequest.title: RunRequest
RunRequest.description: `evidence run` over one corpus into `$EV/runs/<group>/<name>` (the runbook's layout).

id.title: Id
id.description: the directory under the scores root, parts joined by `~`

ScoreRequest.title: ScoreRequest
ScoreRequest.description:
`evaluate score --question-id <the question the run's protocol asks>` of an engine run (with the corpus's
baselines of that question beside it) into `$EV/scores/<group>/<name>`.

Screen.title: Screen
Screen.description:
Per-document screening before any extraction (Part D, the funnel; ours): is the paper one the protocol
can use at all? `terms` feed the regex screen (no hit: not relevant); the cascade decides the rest.
`lexical_miss`: a regex "not relevant" ends the cascade (`reject`, the default) or passes the document on
to the next screen extractor (`escalate`; the keyword list may miss synonyms).
`spec` is the pseudo evidence type the engine runs the screen calls on, so they are checked, cached and
replayed exactly like extractor calls.

Segment.title: Segment
Segment.description:
A piece of a paper's text: `marks` are the ids (items, facts) whose spans cover it, `roles` their roles.
Cut on the server, in code points, so the page never converts offsets.

phase.title: Phase
phase.description: research, conclude, attach, ... (the model call's phase)

fact_id.title: Fact Id
fact_id.description: attach step: the answer fact this step works on

Study.title: Study
Study.description: One study of answer.json (A4 with C3 and F1); the baselines give only document and direction.

SynthRequest.title: SynthRequest
SynthRequest.description: `synth build --renderer template` (no model); writes `<name>-<level>` per level and `<name>-mixed`.

SystemCost.title: SystemCost
SystemCost.description:
One system's cost on a question (evaluation/score.py `system_cost`): model calls and tokens; a count the
system does not report is null (the agent baseline does not split input and output tokens).

next.title: Next
next.description: pass as `after` for the following page

done.title: Done
done.description: answer.json is written: the run has finished

n.title: N
n.description: row number from 1, stable while the run grows; `after` pages by it

at.title: At
at.description: ISO time: a call's start, an event's end (an extractor_call's start)

call.title: Call
call.description: what GET /runs/{run}/calls/{call} takes: a call id (events) or a calls.jsonl key

TraceRow.title: TraceRow
TraceRow.description: One step of the run trace: a warm-pass model call (calls.jsonl) or an engine event (events.jsonl).

TruthAnswer.title: TruthAnswer
TruthAnswer.description: ground_truth.json `answer`: the label the corpus is built to have.

UnknownAnswer.title: UnknownAnswer
UnknownAnswer.description: An answer.json of a kind this viewer does not know: kept as written so the run page still loads.

VariantInfo.title: VariantInfo
VariantInfo.description: variant.json of a counterfactual corpus (`synth variant`, F3).

Waiver.title: Waiver
Waiver.description: A failed critic check a person accepted in decisions.yaml.

check.title: Check
check.description: the critic check id the person accepts as failing

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: why it is safe: at least 10 characters (cards.waivers)

WordList.title: WordList
WordList.description:
Names per thing id (20-50 written by the LLM, `written_by`), the cue words, and the ontology's names kept
apart in `ontology_names`.

evidence__plan__Decision.title: Decision
evidence__plan__Decision.description:
One choice the planner made; `confirmed_by` stays None until a human confirms it. Type `main_rule` is the
main-answer rule (its value one of evidence.planner.RULES); type `direction` says whether a measure is better
higher or lower (id "direction:<measure id>", value "higher" | "lower"). Neither fills a query parameter by itself
nor is rerun.
